description: Publication collection of selected original definitions and their transitive dependencies.

adaptations.change: Allow the manuscript's ordered display-day subset D1,D3,D5 in the odd/even map plotting guard; numerical maps and statistics are unchanged.
Replace a machine-specific T-maze root default with None, resolved relative to the supplied repository root. Main figure workflows supply separate release inputs explicitly.
Replace the historical Windows drive prefix in provenance contracts with the logical prefix source-projects/T-maze/. These paths describe historical sources, not the runtime input directory.
Normalize UTF-8 text and LF newlines for consistent Git checkouts.
Provide current-figure orchestration, explicit inputs, exports, checks and a labelled synthetic decoder example.

hashes: Original-file and definition hashes identify the historical sources. release_file_sha256 and release_files.sha256 identify the adapted publication files. Historical contract hashes remain source-record identifiers.
